pairs.subject: interview-calendar-integrity
pairs.evidence: app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:367 The confirm-time re-check is three-valued and lets an unknown result proceed, but the null branch is never recorded on the booking (confirmScheduleInvite takes no verification flag and schedule_invites has no such column), so the recruiter cannot tell which bookings were made without a verified calendar; the event write also relies on Google's unstated notification default, and a test pins that.

techniques.evidence: app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:367 Re-check runs at booking and only a definite false refuses (409 with re-offer), but the unknown branch books with nothing recorded on the invite, which breaks the 'record the branch taken on the booking' rule and the technique's tell.

app/api/schedule/route.ts:85 The recruiter read carries the full checked/not_connected/unavailable/needs_reconnect status alongside the slots, and an unknown result falls back to the unfiltered pre-integration list.
app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:181 The public token wire carries one bit; calendarStatus and droppedForConflict go only to the workspace-authenticated recruiter route (route.ts:85-86).

app/api/schedule/[token]/route.ts:142 Both suggestion and confirm read the invite's stored durationMin, and the store refuses on real-interval overlap or the coarse hour inside the .immediate() transaction (route.ts:219).

app/api/schedule/calendar-writeback.test.ts:154 One event per interview (reschedule PATCHes, close deletes, a failed delete becomes 'orphaned' with the handle kept), but the provider notification setting is deliberately omitted and the test pins its absence instead of stating sendUpdates=none explicitly, which the technique names as a failure.

pairs.evidence: app/schedule/[token]/SlotPicker.tsx:112 The candidate surface renders exactly one derived bit (checked or not checked) with no hidden count and no failure cause, and on a 409 it re-offers the current times, so the candidate is neither shown the interviewer's schedule density nor left at a dead end.

techniques.evidence: app/schedule/[token]/SlotPicker.tsx:112 One bit of copy; no busy count, no integration name or error.
app/schedule/[token]/use-schedule-invite.ts:107 Strict equality: an absent or unknown value renders the cautious 'not confirmed' copy and never the affirmative one.
app/schedule/[token]/use-schedule-invite.ts:188 A confirm-time refusal re-fetches and shows the current slots in place, not a dead end.

pairs.evidence: app/_lib/interview-planned-minutes.ts:74 plannedInterviewMinutes is the single source for the invite's durationMin, which every conflict check reads. But an entry with no follow-ups, no kit and no grounded prep gets the 5-minute quick-screen floor, so the interview is conflict-checked against the interviewer's calendar as a 5-minute interval: the silent, undershooting default the technique says produces confident, wrong all-clears.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/interview-planned-minutes.ts:74 One duration source shared by mint, grid book and conflict check (good), but an unknown length falls to QUICK_SCREEN_MIN=5 on the normal path, not a documented legacy fallback.
